[b][<★> You've got Mail!][/b]

An invitation to the Prime Minister in Exile & the Royals in Exile to Hyperion has been sent to Elseyr for the Exiles Government on behalf of the Imperial Court of Vespurias via means of the Imperial Steward Office, with an extra invitation for the Admiral in Exile by the Grand Princess 'Mary' to Kingsmount City. Meanwhile an invitation to the Imperial Steward of Elseyr has been given by the Imperial Steward of Vespurias, more privately, to organise the future imperial meeting of the Empires and their Emperors for a prepared future ceremonial unification celebration as well as official state matters.

[/spoiler][/quote]

[b]An Invitiation[/b]

Outside the central palace at a table, Admiral Vivian and Prime Minister Romain looked down at the letter they had just been handed

"So...are we really going to this?" Admiral Vivian asked the "Prime Minister" 

Romain simply looked confused at the question "Do we have a choice?"

"I seriously doubt it. We wouldn't want to risk our already very tenacious position by refusing. It could be taken as an insult," responded Vivian, looking back down at the letter.

"The bigger question, I guess, is whether the royals are going to accept this? They haven't been the most talkative since we've left Komend." 

"Eh...does it matter what they think? Seriously. We seriously aren't going let them being angsty ruin this for us."

Romain looked at Vivian surprised, "They lost their parents, Vivian. I know they haven't been the most cooperative, but give them a break."

"Anyway..." The admiral trying to change the subject

"I'll radio the royal guards to go get them down for us. You go get a cab and make sure you tell the Vespurian Embassy we would be happy to accept their request."

"Whatever. I'll be back soon, Admiral."

As the prime minister leaves, grabbing a piece of paper and an envelope embossed with the Royal and Government Seals of the Kingdom, the Admiral radios the royal guards to inform the royals to get ready in their proper uniforms.
_______________________________________________________________________

"What?!" 

Gaberial yelled out loud after the royal guard had left the room

"Okay wait hang on a f*cking second...I didn't agree to this. I told the admiral. I'm done. I don't want the throne, and I most certainly don't want to leave this guarded palace to get on some plane or boat where im just going to be hunted by some revolutionari-"

"Gabe, please shut up. You're going to wake up anne at this rate. She needs sleep. We haven't had alot of it." [Maximilien says quietly, gabe grumbles a bit before speaking again, more composed

"Look, Max, all I'm saying is that, you know. Lying low is usually done quietly. I don't even really consider myself a prince anymore. And unlike you two, I'm an adult."

Maximilien rolls his eyes "I get it but...like us, your also not in any position to refuse what the admiral wants. If he wants us to dance for him in front of the Vespurians...then I guess we got to do just that."

Gabe sighs and looks and looks at the stack of Thrømm cash on the counter

"Eh. I guess you have a point...for once anyway. We're getting new phones, though. And I'm going to get myself some wine...they better have some good sh*t here... I'm going to need it." Gaberial says, walking over and grabbing around 3000 Lyr 

"Oh, really? Get me some."

"F*ck off, max."

On behalf of His Majesty's Government of Floueschia and the House of Zeveden

We would like to formally accept both the Imperial Court of Vespurias's invitation to the City of Hyperion and Grand Princess Mary's invitation of the Admiral to the city of Kingsmount. We also graciously thank both parties for the opportunity and their willingness to host us despite the current situation concerning our status as the legitimate, but exiled, government of the Confederate Kingdom of Floueschia. We will be arriving shortly after this message arrives to you.

With grace, Prime Minister Romain Feltgen
